title: Replace Simiron-hosted flake color images with 17 user-uploaded images

requirements.summary: Replace all Simiron CDN-hosted images in the FlakeColorsSection component with 17 user-uploaded images stored as local assets, mapped to their confirmed color names in the exact order specified by the user
acceptanceCriteria: All 17 flake color cards in the FlakeColorsSection display the user-uploaded images instead of any Simiron CDN or Unsplash URLs
Each image is correctly matched to its confirmed color name in the specified order
Images load from frontend/public/assets/generated using local paths only
No external image dependencies (Simiron CDN or Unsplash) remain in FlakeColorsSection
The responsive grid layout and color name labels are preserved exactly as before

file_operations.description: Replace the flakeColors array with 17 entries that reference the user-uploaded images stored in frontend/public/assets/ (IMG_2262.jpeg through IMG_2275.jpeg). Map each image to its confirmed color name in the exact order: 1. Tidal Wave (IMG_2262.jpeg), 2. Gravel Blend (IMG_2260.jpeg), 3. Coyote Blend (IMG_2261.jpeg), 4. Wombat Blend (IMG_2259.jpeg), 5. Stargazer Blend (IMG_2263.jpeg), 6. Outback Blend (IMG_2266.jpeg), 7. Orbit Blend (IMG_2267.jpeg), 8. Safari Blend (IMG_2265.jpeg), 9. Creekbed Blend (IMG_2270.jpeg), 10. Nightfall (IMG_2268.jpeg), 11. Glacier Blend (IMG_2272.jpeg), 12. Stonewash Blend (IMG_2273.jpeg), 13. Shoreline Blend (IMG_2264.jpeg), 14. Domino Blend (IMG_2269.jpeg), 15. Cabin Fever (IMG_2275.jpeg), 16. Feather Gray Blend (IMG_2274.jpeg), 17. Autumn Brown Blend (IMG_2271.jpeg). Remove all Simiron CDN URLs and Unsplash fallback URLs. Use local asset paths only (e.g., /assets/IMG_2262.jpeg). Preserve the existing component structure, responsive grid layout, color name labels, and CTA link to the contact section exactly as they are.
